request: Build a small Jac web app for teams and invitations. Team members are owner, admin or member. Owners and admins invite an email with a role; the invite has a token that expires after 7 days (the current time is passed in). Accepting a valid invite joins the team with that role. Only owners can make someone an owner, and a team always keeps at least one owner.
acceptance: Accepting an expired or already-used token fails and creates no membership.
A plain member cannot invite anyone, and an admin cannot invite someone as owner.
Demoting or removing the last remaining owner is rejected.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.
